name: %name%
author: Piomio
offer: Browser traffic: with it on, agents see what the pages in their browser ask the network and get back (the API calls behind a page, as in a browser's developer tools), save them to a file, block requests, replace answers, and send requests of their own from the browser. Cookies, tokens and passwords stay hidden from them. Changing what the browser sends, or sending a request that is not a GET, still asks the person each time. Useful for work with web apps, for finding a site's data behind its page, and for testing. Turn it on with hub_plugin_enable {id: "browser-traffic", enabled: true} when the person wants it.
